title: Sax-O-Phun
identity: Tierolff's Sax-O-Phun is Rudy Wiedoeft's alto saxophone and piano study, subtitled Study in Laugh & Slap Tongue (SA2385). A one-page public saxophone preview was visually inspected.

evidence.claim: Tierolff listing identifies the title, scoring and subtitling.
Public score preview shows alto saxophone line, laugh syllables and explicit slap-tongue notation.

score_observations: The inspected one-page preview labels the solo Eb alto saxophone and piano accompaniment. It prints four opening laugh syllables, many later laugh cues and multiple slap-tongue marks; the displayed passage includes accented gestures, chromatic accidentals and rapid note movement. This is one preview page, not the full work.
review_focus: Inspect full edition for tempo, range, rhythmic demands, and whether modern performer can execute indicated laugh/slap effects consistently.
collection_flag: A virtuosic novelty-era solo whose effects are explicit in the score; it is not presented as a conventional lyrical study.

score_links.description: Public score preview shows alto saxophone line, laugh syllables and explicit slap-tongue notation.

gaps: Only the first sample page was accessible; no contrasting late passage or full range inspected.
No verified saxophone recording was auditioned.
